messages.author: 54788cf3a8eb8916
messages.subject: rstan 2.3 install docs
parts:
Good day to you,

I installed rstan 2.3 using the new installer and as the documentation did not say that I had to leave R and restart, I tried the 8-schools example which failed to compile.  Once I restarted R, everything was fine.  Suggestion: a note in the quick-start guide that you might need to restart R.

--
Kind regards,

Sean O'Riordain
seor...@tcd.ie
